The fork carries a build cache (oleans dated 2026-07-27 11:24-11:25) that post-dates every DA/OmegaRegularLanguage source mtime (latest 11:20:41), so 32 axiom profiles were measured in one lake env lean run with no rebuild: every theorem is exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], no sorryAx. Sorry-freeness established by measurement rather than grep.

The research report supplied verbatim replacement text for the completeness-programme report's row 16 and verdict inference (its Finding 3, 'What this changes in the record'), so the two record-amendment phases were authorable as anchored sentence edits with confirmed grep targets rather than requiring the planner to re-derive the amended wording. All six anchors in the 879 report and both ROADMAP anchors were confirmed present at plan time.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification check warned on Phase 3: suite_selection_select returns __FULL_SWEEP__ for any path SET containing a sentinel-mapped path, so listing this plan's own path alongside specs/ROADMAP.md in Files to modify collapsed the selector output to the sentinel and made the honest two-suite claim read as fabricated. Resolved by excluding the plan-notes bookkeeping path from Phase 3's Files to modify (matching the precedent plan's Phase 3) and saying so explicitly in the Scope Hypothesis; the notes-writing step is kept in the task list. Plan now validates with 0 warnings.

All six Phase 1 anchor greps in the completeness-programme report matched exactly once before editing, at the line numbers the plan recorded at plan time (33, 198, 221, 239, 251, 278 in a 286-line file). No anchor had to be re-located by content, and git diff -U0 showed exactly the seven hunks the Scope Hypothesis predicted.

Phase 1's verification criterion ('each of the six greps matches exactly once after the edit') is unsatisfiable for three of its own anchors: the task list mandates REPLACING the text those three greps match ('not formalizable at this Mathlib pin' in row 16; the compound 'Mathlib has no ω-automata and no determinization, and the standing ruling' whose second half must be dropped; 'nor any ω-automata determinization project' which must be narrowed). Those three now count 0 by design. Substituted the correct check: each anchor's deliberately-KEPT half still counts 1 (verified: the exec-summary 'Mathlib has no ω-automata and no determinization' clause, recommendation 6's 'do not file a Lean formalization' clause and its 'until P9 reports' gating, and the byte-identical NO-GO verdict opening).

Phase 1's row-16 instruction says to replace 'the third column' while keeping 'the row's first two columns byte-identical', but the ingredient table has FOUR columns (#, Ingredient, Status, Evidence/proposal) and the overturned ground lives in the fourth. Resolved by replacing the fourth (Evidence/proposal) cell with the report's verbatim text and leaving the Status cell 'paper (held: Safra/Piterman in corpus)' intact, since the ingredient is still a paper-level step and the Status cell carried none of the overturned claim.

Phase 1's plan-file [IN PROGRESS] marker was not set before the first edit; the heading went straight from [NOT STARTED] to [COMPLETED] after the edits and verification were done. No consequence here (single-agent dispatch, no resume between), but the phase-boundary marker contract was not honoured in order for Phase 1. Phases 2-4 set the marker before their first edit.

state-write.sh --audit-verdict passes its payload through argv (--argjson verdicts), so the 128 KB per-argv ceiling applies. The plan's stated remedy -- 'slice the committed audit file to a one-line per-proposal file for each call' -- is INSUFFICIENT here: audit-task-proposals.sh already emits exactly one line per proposal, and each line is ~140 KB because it carries 452 scope-blind verdicts (one per corpus record declaring no file_scope). Remedy applied: per-proposal condensed slices that keep every non-scope-blind verdict verbatim (13 for the Muller proposal, 19 for the method-lessons proposal) and collapse the 452 scope-blind verdicts to a count plus a provenance note, per backlog-reconciliation.md's own Pass 1 rendering guidance that scope-blind be rendered as a count. 66 KB each, under the ceiling. The unabridged 140 KB-per-line audit is committed at task-proposals-audit.ndjson, so no evidence is lost.

Phase 2's verification says 'validate-state.sh exits 0, cycle check included', but the dependency-cycle check is Check D5 inside the --deep block; a bare 'bash .claude/scripts/validate-state.sh' runs only the 10 base-mode checks and never reaches it. Re-ran as 'validate-state.sh --deep': 19 passed, 19 warnings (all pre-existing legacy file_scope visibility), 0 failed, exit 0, with 'No dependency cycles detected among active_projects' and 'TODO.md is in sync' both explicitly observed.

Phase 2's task list claims the five source-store paths in the method-lessons file_scope were 'confirmed present at plan time except the new pattern file'. Not reproducible: this repository's .claude-extensions.json has NO source_dir key (keys are only 'extensions' and 'version'), there is no agent-system/ tree in this repo or anywhere under ~/Projects, so the source store is unreachable from here. The filing stands unchanged -- file_scope is descriptive rather than filesystem-validated, and the plan's own Phase 2 Scope Hypothesis explicitly anticipates source-store paths that do not exist in this tree. Both lessons re-confirmed genuinely unimplemented via the deployed mirror instead: .claude/context/project/lean4/domain/metadata-trust-surfaces.md contains 0 occurrences of 'proof_wanted', and .claude/context/project/lean4/patterns/external-library-dependency-assessment.md does not exist.

The backlog audit cleared both proposals without any narrowing. The ONLY duplicate-of-open verdict across both was a self-match against task 902 itself (semantic_score 0.48, mechanical_class none) -- rejected on inspection, since 902 is a report-only research task whose own report explicitly declines to answer the Muller question and recommends filing it. The two tasks the plan named for inspection came back clear: 901 scored 0.219/0.167 with verdict scope-blind only, and 895 emitted no verdict at all. 901's own description independently CONFIRMS the edge direction the plan wanted: it names 'the two deterministic Rabin automata over colour words' as its subject matter, so it presupposes the very answer the new task settles, making 903 genuinely upstream of 901 rather than inside its remit.

Phase 3's anticipated environment failure reproduced exactly as the plan's Risks row predicted, carried forward from task 879's own measurement: test-roadmap-generation.sh exits 2 with 'ERROR: roadmap-integration.sh not found (mode=source-store): .../agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/roadmap-integration.sh'. Because the plan named the covering substitute up front, no discovery cost was paid: roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate --dry-run exits 0 and --print exits 0 against the amended file, and test-engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh passes. The carried calibration from the precedent task paid off.

Phase 3's task list and Scope Hypothesis both assert that specs/ROADMAP.md's '**Coverage appendix (uncovered tasks)**:' marker 'is below both' anchors, and direct that no hunk land at or after it. Measured false: the marker is at line 171 (pre-edit), ABOVE anchor 2 at line 321. The plan's stated check is therefore unsatisfiable for anchor 2. The underlying hazard is narrower than the plan's framing: ROADMAP.md's own Maintenance section states that strip_coverage_appendix discards everything after the marker *within the run-order section* only, and that roadmap-integration.sh --regenerate retains every other '## ' section byte-for-byte. Both anchors sit outside the run-order section (## Run these next, lines 139-181 pre-edit) -- anchor 1 in ## Rulings in force and anchor 2 in ## Do not re-attempt -- so both are safe. Substituted check, which passes: neither of the two hunks (lines 114 and 329) falls inside the run-order section, and no /orchestrate line in the coverage appendix changed.

Phase 4's full gate set came back green first try: verify-deploy.sh 'PASS -- 15 check(s), 0 failure(s)', exit 0, with 22 of 27 checks skipping because this repository is a deploy consumer rather than the source store -- the same unreachable-source-store fact that Phase 2 discovered independently and that Phase 3's suite exit-2 is caused by. Three independent surfaces converged on one root cause, which is worth noting: the 22 SKIPs, test-roadmap-generation.sh's source-store subject resolution, and the absent source_dir key in .claude-extensions.json are all the same condition, and none of them is a defect in this task's work.
